# 1.2.106 - Newer Daggerheart and Foundry: a player's save in Daggerheart 2.12.5's shape no longer dropped, no player's roll drawn by the GM on Daggerheart 2.12 until its new action road is reworked, Dice So Nice 6.4's saved marker held with the table's dice look; the harness runs Foundry's old keys both ways

Stage E76 alone, built on its own line from 1.2.105. Its commits are five on the E76 branch (C2 987c0742, C4
a4f44282, C5 10ea1ea8, C3 part 7130fb45, C6 a6ecbbb9), their merge onto 1.2.105 (dcec47ab), decda243, and 60dc0a54,
the stage row's `touches` in tools/stages.json. The versions it was measured against, on 12.11.2026: Daggerheart
**2.12.8** (tag commit 71c318de25, 11.11.2026), Dice So Nice **6.4.5**, and Foundry **14.370** - Foundry's read
secondhand, through a search, because foundryvtt.com was not reachable from the work session. In plain words:

- **A player's save on Daggerheart 2.12.5 and later.** From 2.12.5 Daggerheart sends a player's save from a chat
  card as `saveTotal` and `isCritical` instead of `result`. The module's guard read only the old shape, so on those
  versions every player's save was dropped as "a save with no roll in it" and never marked on the card (read in
  Daggerheart's code, measured headless). The guard now judges a save the same way in either shape - the sender
  must own the token, the total must be a number - and passes the one judged total on in both shapes, for either
  Daggerheart's handler to read (that 2.12.5's handler then marks the card is not yet measured: LIVE-E76-02). On
  Daggerheart up to 2.12.4 a save is judged as before.
- **On Daggerheart 2.12 no player's roll is drawn by the GM.** Daggerheart 2.12 (read in 2.12.8's code, not run)
  builds an action roll through a new step (a `MoveContext`) that keeps none of the marks the module puts on the
  roll. Without this release the GM would most likely have drawn every player's action as a plain statistic roll from the sheet
  (read in 2.12.8's code and the draw's review, not run). Now, when Daggerheart's `rollTrait` builds a MoveContext
  (or its source cannot be read), the module does not install the GM's draw at all: every player's roll - action
  rolls and rolls from the sheet alike - is thrown in the player's own browser, as before 1.2.67, and the GMs are
  told once per Daggerheart version. On Daggerheart 2.10 nothing changes, unless another module replaces the
  actor's `rollTrait` with one whose source cannot be read. The real fix is not in this release (Before installing).
- **One dice look for the table, on Dice So Nice 6.4.** Dice So Nice 6.4 gives a user who never saved a look of
  their own the default special effects other packages register, and mixes its basic look under theirs. With **One
  dice look for the table** on, the module now also writes Dice So Nice's `saved` marker
  (`{ appearance: true, sfx: true }`) with the table's look, so a player keeps the GM's look and no special effects
  of their own (read in Dice So Nice 6.4.5's source; at a table it is LIVE-E76-07). With the setting off nothing is written, as before.
- **For the module's own tests only, no change at the table**: the headless harness runs Foundry's old update keys
  `-=` and `==` both ways (doing nothing, as the module's own notes measured it, LIVE-E30-01 still open on v14; deleting and
  replacing, as Foundry issue 14806 reads for 14.369 and later), and a test pins what the secret passages' cut leans
  on in Foundry's line-of-sight sweep to Foundry 14.370 as its published typings declare it.

Nothing in this version ran at a real table or on a Foundry server; what was measured was measured headless.
Below, an R number names one of the module's own tests (`game.drpg.runTests()`), and a scenario one of the headless
harness's multi-browser runs. The gaps are in Not in this release, Known gaps and Checked.

## Before installing

- **On Daggerheart 2.12 no player's roll is drawn by the GM** - action rolls and rolls from the sheet alike: the
  dice are thrown in the player's browser, as before 1.2.67, until E76b. A GM on Daggerheart 2.12 meets this on the
  upgrade: 1.2.105 would most likely have drawn them there (read in the code, not run), 1.2.106 leaves the GM's draw out at every
  load there and says so once per version (below).
- **Daggerheart 2.12: a player's action roll likely loses the module's marks, and the full fix is not in this
  release.** On Daggerheart 2.12 (read against 2.12.8's code, not run), what the module adds to an action roll -
  which action it is, the mark that lets the GM claim the roll, the Loaded Die, a statistic the GM chose, the roll
  window's settings - does not reach the roll. This release only keeps the GM from drawing such rolls wrongly: every
  player's roll is thrown in the player's browser instead. What is left of the module's action roll after that on
  2.12 - its card, Hope, the Calls, the roll window - is not known (LIVE-E76-04). The full fix, carrying the module's marks
  through Daggerheart's MoveContext, is **E76b, not in this release**; it waits on the owner. A table that relies on
  the module's action rolls is safer on the Daggerheart it runs now, if that is older than 2.12.
- **What a GM sees on Daggerheart 2.12**: once per Daggerheart version, a whisper to the GMs, "Daggerheart {version}
  builds its rolls in a way this module was not written for, so the players' rolls are thrown in their own browsers
  and not drawn by the GM. Said once for this version." (the existing text, in English and Polish), and in the
  browser console "Rolls are not drawn by the GM on this Daggerheart (2.12.8): the actor's rollTrait builds a
  MoveContext, which keeps none of the module's roll marks." On Daggerheart 2.10 neither appears, unless another
  module replaces the actor's `rollTrait` with one whose source cannot be read.
- **No world migration.** No setting or language key of the module's was added or renamed. On the first load with
  One dice look for the table on, the primary GM writes Dice So Nice's `saved` marker to every player, trusted
  player and Assistant GM, offline ones included (below).
- **Dice So Nice's `saved` flag on players**: with One dice look for the table on, every player, trusted player and
  Assistant GM is written `dice-so-nice.saved` `{ appearance: true, sfx: true }` beside the table's look: by the
  primary GM's sweep of every such user, offline ones too, at Dice So Nice's ready, at a user's connect and at a
  put-back; a player's own change of it goes back, as their look does. A full
  Gamemaster's own look is never written. Switching the setting off writes nothing and gives nothing back.
- **`module.json`**: unchanged but for the version. Foundry `minimum` 14.364, `verified` 14.365; Daggerheart
  `minimum` 2.6.5, `verified` 2.6.5, no `maximum` (decision D1), so a newer Daggerheart loads and the module warns
  the GM once per version. No `verified` is raised without a check at a real table (release.md step 6; LIVE-E76-01).

## A player's save in both shapes (E76 C2 987c0742)

- `relay-guard.mjs` `judgeSave`: reads `saveTotal` and `isCritical` when the packet carries a `saveTotal` key, else
  the old `result.roll`, and forwards the one judged total in both shapes. Red first: R3600 "a save in 2.12.5's shape
  for the sender's own token is not forwarded (a save with no roll in it) - expected "forward", measured "drop""
  ("2 passed, 1 failed" with R133), and scenario 33's new check "A8: a player's save in Daggerheart 2.12.5's shape is
  marked on the card, with its total and critical" with `saves2: null` on a copy of the tree with the old guard. Green: "3 passed, 0 failed";
  33-bridge-paths 74/74. Mutants: forwarding without `saveTotal`/`isCritical`, dropping the owner check, and a null
  `saveTotal` read from `result` each KILLED (the last after a test was added for it; it first survived).
- Not as the plan had it: the plan wanted the guard to forward in the shape the running Daggerheart reads, told by
  reading its handler. The handler lives where the guard cannot read its arguments, so both shapes are sent; a third
  shape would still not be seen (Known gaps). A default the owner may revise.

## The draw left off Daggerheart 2.12 (E76 C3, the part done, 7130fb45)

- `roll-draw.mjs` `seamFor` also reads the Actor class's `rollTrait`: one that names a MoveContext, or one whose
  source cannot be read, is "changed". Read in 2.12.8: `rollTrait` (actor.mjs :727-743) builds
  `MoveContext.build({ ..., ...options, actor })`, and MoveContext's constructor copies only the properties it names
  and sets `dialog` to `{}`. Red first: R3602 measured `["ok","ok","ok","ok"]` where `["changed","ok","ok","changed"]`
  was expected. Green: R3602, R217; 83-roll-integrity 110/110, 20-crit-hope 6/6. Mutant: the unreadable-source check
  dropped KILLED.

## Dice So Nice 6.4's saved marker (E76 C6 a6ecbbb9)

- `dice-sync.mjs` `SAVED_MARK`: written with the look (`writeLooks`), and a user holds the table's look only with both
  marks true (`holdsTableLook`), so the sweep, the connect and the put-back write it. Read in Dice So Nice 6.4.5's
  source (tag b365efc, 04.11.2026; `DsnSettings.js`). Red first: R3603 measured `[true,true,true,true,true,true]`
  where `[true,false,false,false,false,true]` was expected; scenario 17's new G1b with every client's marker null and
  p1's own `{ appearance: false, sfx: false }` standing. Green: R3603, R940 (its stubs now carry the marker, so it
  still reads the look alone), 17-assistant 46/46, tier 2 "dice look" "37 passed, 0 failed (33 ran)" with the world
  put back (STATUS.md's figures; what the 37 count beyond the 33 tests is not in the record). Mutant: the check of
  `appearance` alone KILLED.
- Also read, no change: Dice So Nice 6.3+ has no `Dice3D.ALL_CUSTOMIZATION` (it is a static of its internal
  `DsnSettings`), so the module's table look comes from the GM's raw `appearance` flag, as its comment already said.
  Daggerheart 2.12.8 registers no default effects of its own (no `addSFXDefaults` in its code); another module may.

## The harness: Foundry's old keys both ways (E76 C4 a4f44282)

- `lib/operators.mjs` `legacyReading()`: "ignored" (the default, the model since E30) or "honoured" (the cluster turns
  `-=key` into a ForcedDeletion and `==key` into a ForcedReplacement before the write is judged). `DRPG_LEGACY_KEYS`
  picks a run's reading, a scenario's `legacyReading` export wins, every results file records it. Scenarios
  91-old-keys-ignored and 92-old-keys-honoured run one body (`lib/old-keys.mjs`), both in CI. Red first: 92 on a copy
  of the tree with the old harness files, 4/8. Green: 91 8/8, 92 8/8, 00-boot 33/33. In 92 a player's `-=` on a
  GM-only flag of the student they own is put back by the primary GM with one `putBack` row naming them: the module
  already judged a `-=` part as the whole key, so no module change. The default stays "ignored": "honoured" is read
  off an issue title, not measured (LIVE-E76-03). A default the owner may revise.

## The passages' cut pinned to Foundry 14.370 (E76 C5 10ea1ea8)

- R3601: what `PassageMovePolygon` and `clipPassages` lean on, held to foundry-vtt-types 14.370.0 (commit 2923f0c5,
  07.11.2026) - `edges` a Set, `_identifyEdges()` with no argument, `new Edge(a, b, options)` with only the nine Edge
  options - and this Foundry's sight backend to the same members. Typings, not Foundry's source. A pin, so nothing in
  the module to be red; its mutants (an extra option in the cut, an argument passed to `_identifyEdges`, the harness's
  `_identifyEdges` taking a parameter) each KILLED.

## Not in this release

- **E76b, the Daggerheart 2.12 action-roll fix** (the module's marks carried through a MoveContext): split off E76
  rather than shipped half done (the plan's Q-E76-5 default, taken on 12.11.2026). It waits on the owner's decision.
  Until it ships, on Daggerheart 2.12 no player's roll is drawn by the GM - action rolls and rolls from the sheet
  alike are thrown in the player's browser, as above.
- **C1, the harness's copy of Daggerheart's relay from 2.12.8**: `audit/harness/lib/dh-relay.mjs` is a byte-for-byte
  copy the work line may not edit (the owner's rule); it is still 2.10.11's. So that Daggerheart 2.12.5's own handler
  marks the card from what the guard sends is not measured headless (LIVE-E76-02). It waits on the owner's decision.
- **C3's dice copy from 2.12.8**: `audit/harness/lib/dh-dice/`, the same rule; the harness still throws with
  Daggerheart 2.10.5's dice. Read, not run: the draw's review of a build checks its structure, not its version, and
  2.12.8's build would most likely pass it - which is why C3's part above reads `rollTrait` too. It waits on the
  owner's decision.
- **The census of Foundry 14.366-14.370's notes**: foundryvtt.com was not reachable from the work session, so no
  item of those notes was checked against the module, and the census rows for the passages (Foundry's `Edge`,
  `PointMovementSource`, per-Level edges, `TokenDocument#movement`, the wall fields, `teleport`, `displace`,
  `BaseWall.#canUpdate`, "releasing control cancels the drag") were not written.
- **The table's look on Daggerheart 2.10+ dice roles** (`dice-look.mjs` `layOnThrow`): not read further.
- **`verified` in module.json**: not raised for Foundry 14.370 or Daggerheart 2.12.8, since neither was tried at a
  real table (Q-E76-4; LIVE-E76-01).

## Known gaps

- **Daggerheart 2.12's rolls** (Before installing): no player's roll drawn by the GM, every one thrown in the
  player's browser; an action roll's module marks likely lost; E76b not in this release.
- **A third shape of the save packet** would not be seen: the guard's fingerprint of Daggerheart's relay reads its
  case list, which did not change from 2.10.11 to 2.12.8, and did not catch this change either. No second signal was
  added.
- **The harness runs older Daggerheart code**: its relay copy is 2.10.11's and its dice copy 2.10.5's, so 2.12's
  save handler and 2.12's dice are not measured headless.
- **Foundry's old keys**: which of the two readings Foundry 14.370 has is not known; the harness defaults to
  "ignored". The module itself spells no `-=` (R152). The root rules file's line on `-=` is unchanged; new wording is
  proposed in docs/dev/e76/STATUS.md.
- **Foundry 14.370** is known secondhand; the items reported for it that touch the module (world time an integer,
  sounds that really stop, ESC on popped-out windows, a released drag cancelled, and the rest of the plan's list)
  were not reviewed in this release.
- **The live checks** (AUDIT 9.2, items 475-481), not yet done at a real table: LIVE-E76-01 the module on Foundry
  14.370, Daggerheart 2.12.8 and Dice So Nice 6.4.5 with no console error and `runTests({ tier: 2 })` 0 failed (LIVE-E75-05 for
  these versions); 02 a player's save on 2.12.8 marked once by the primary GM; 03 whether a `-=key` deletes on
  14.370; 04 on 2.12.8 a player's action roll thrown in the player's
  browser, and what is left of the module's roll there (its card, Hope, the Calls, the roll window); 05 the table's
  dice look on Dice So Nice 6.4.5 in both themes; 06 a secret passage and a drag released mid-way on 14.370; 07 the
  `saved` marker on 6.4.5 for a player who never saved a look and one who did, with a module that registers default
  effects.
